status: PRODUCTION DRIVING BASE - Diane Marchetti. Blink-cadence corrected. In use by all 22 CLAIMS-01 AV1 segments.
purpose: Reusable driving video for LatentSync. Derived from the approved motion base by RE-ORDERING its frames only. Generated once; reused across Diane's catalog.

derived_from.unchanged: The approved motion base is untouched and verified byte-identical after this build.

why.defect: The approved 5.04 s motion base contains FOUR blinks (frames 13-18, 34-38, 56-59, 105-110) = 47.6 blinks/min in the source itself. LatentSync pingpong-looped it to cover the narration, delivering 48.9 blinks/min on a fixed 10.0 s repeat, with half of every delivered blink played BACKWARDS on the reverse leg of the pingpong.

method.cost: $0.00 - ffmpeg only. No new generation, no Kling call, no TTS.
method.pixels: Every output frame is a BIT-EXACT copy of a frame of the approved base. Only the ORDER changes. No filtering, no colour work, no scaling, no upscale.
method.source_region: Frames 60-120 only - the settled on-camera pose, which contains exactly ONE blink (105-110). Frames 0-60 are a one-way settling drift carrying three of the four blinks and cannot be revisited without a visible pose jump; discarded.
method.walk: A CONTINUOUS walk along the source frame index, every step +-1, so no move contains a cut. Direction runs are 12-55 frames (0.50-2.29 s); turns read as the head settling.
method.blinks: Emitted by walking FORWARD through 105->110 only. Verified structurally: 22 traversals, each exactly [105,106,107,108,109,110], zero entered backwards.
method.joins: 22 joins, one per blink, returning from the post-blink tail to the working range. Max join = 1.675 whole-frame RMS vs 2.045 for the LARGEST step the approved base takes between two of its own consecutive frames - i.e. every join is a smaller visual change than the source's own motion. Median consecutive step: 0.728.
method.encode: libx264 -preset slow -crf 12 -pix_fmt yuv420p -an  (same settings as the approved base)
method.encode_fidelity: PSNR vs the exact re-ordered approved pixels: average 55.64 dB, Y 54.74, min 52.91

blink_schedule.note: Irregular by design, including three clustered doubles. Measured on the delivered segments: 103/103 planned blinks present, 13.3/min aggregate.

why_longer_than_every_call: 99.62 s exceeds the longest LatentSync call (85.12 s), so loop_mode never triggers. That removes the repeating pattern and the reversed blinks structurally rather than statistically.
